messages:
elena: Quick sync — Acme Retail POC. They want a short eval next week (3 devs + 2 security reviewers). Need: hosted API keys for app dev + a small Dedicated pool for load testing, and RBAC so customer engineers only get least-priv access. Can we provision both and share invite flow?
samir: Yep. For Hosted we can spin API keys tonight. For Dedicated I need a pool spec (gpus, concurrency). Do they want VPC/private networking?
elena: They'll want to test Dedicated performance but no private network for initial POC. Just isolation and quotas. Pool target: 1xA10G equivalent, 8 concurrent sessions, burst to 16.
devon: That spec is fine. I can create a Dedicated trial pool and attach it to the sales org. Timeline: ~36 hours to provision and validate. I'll need the customer emails for RBAC invites.
elena: Sending emails now: jordan@acme-retail.com, aman@acme-retail.com, karen@acme-retail.com (the 3 engs) + sec-review@acme-retail.com + gdpr@acme-retail.com (reviewers).
devon: Got them. For least-privilege, we'll create two roles: "poc-engineer" (generate keys, call inference, view usage) and "poc-security" (view logs, download audit only). Use these policies: `role:poc-engineer`, `capabilities:[keys:create,models:invoke,usage:view]` and `role:poc-security`, `capabilities:[audit:read,logs:download]`.
maria: Heads-up: security wants SSO or scoped service accounts for reviewers. If they won't do SSO for POC, we must create time-limited API tokens and enable audit logging. Also they'll ask for answers to the security questionnaire Q12 (data residency) — confirm Hosted inference keeps data in our region unless they request otherwise.
elena: Jordan (customer) — quick Q: do you have SSO? If not, we'll give expiring tokens to reviewers.
jordan: We don't have SSO set up yet for this. Expiring tokens work for now. Also pricing question: how are POC tokens/billing handled?
samir: For POC we apply a temporary credit for Hosted usage; Dedicated trial is billed at a flat trial rate in the contract; we'll send a one-pager with estimated token cost and the trial credit applied.
devon: Access steps I'll follow: 1) create org `acme-poc-1767654321`; 2) provision Dedicated pool `acme-poc-ded-1`; 3) create roles and invite emails; 4) issue expiring reviewer tokens for sec reviewers (7d default). Example invite command (internal):
```
redwood invite --org acme-poc-1767654321 --email jordan@acme-retail.com --role poc-engineer
redwood invite --org acme-poc-1767654321 --email sec-review@acme-retail.com --role poc-security --expiry 7d
```
I'll also enable audit logs and forward retention to the console.
elena: Perfect. Can you also attach a dev key for app integration? One reusable key for the app team with rate limits: 120rpm, token expiry 30d.
devon: Will do. I'll set a usage quota: 100k tokens/day soft limit.
maria: Please attach the short answers for the security questionnaire items they usually request: data flow diagram, retention policy, and encryption at rest/in transit. I can draft those and share.
ops-bot: NOTE: Dedicated pool `acme-poc-ded-1` provisioning scheduled by devon at 2026-03-22T11:00Z.
jordan: Thanks folks — timeline works. Last ask: can you enable per-route latency dashboard so we can compare hosted vs dedicated?
samir: Yes — tracking will be on the console under org -> metrics -> model/route. I'll add a custom dashboard and share link once live.
elena: Great — action items: devon provision + invites (36h), samir prepare POC pricing one-pager, maria prepare security answers. I'll follow up with customer once invites go out. :raised_hands:
